description: Make a receipt file from a template, with your own items, and get a 24-hour download link. Call list_templates for a slug first. Set accept_terms to true. items is required (1 to 200): name, qty and unit_price as decimal strings like "4.50", never numbers; subtotal, tax and total are worked out for you. Every other field you leave out (store name and address, date, currency, tax, payment, discounts, extra_lines, messages, barcode) uses the template's sample value, so pass an empty array to clear discounts, extra_lines or messages. format is png (default), jpeg or pdf. An optional logo goes on top: PNG, JPEG or SVG up to 2 MB (a PNG or JPEG at most 2 megapixels, for example 1600×1250; resize a bigger one first), as file_id (from create_upload), url or data_base64; it replaces the template's logo, and header.logo "none" removes the template's logo. Returns url, expires_at, the delivered image size in pixels (for a PDF, the page at 1x), the totals as formatted strings, and notes for anything that was left out or cut. Free within a daily quota counted in documents (see start.md). Make receipts only for lawful purposes, such as replacing a lost receipt, bookkeeping, testing or design mockups. Using a receipt to deceive anyone, including for refunds, expense claims or proof of purchase, is prohibited.

accept_terms.description: Must be true: you agree to the acceptable-use policy in this tool's description

currency.description: Symbol, decimals (0, 2 or 3) and number format; fields you leave out keep the template's

header.description: Seller name, address lines, alignment and logo choice; fields you leave out keep the template's

logo.description: none removes the template's built-in logo; template keeps it

items.description: What was bought: name, qty and unit_price (decimal strings; a negative price is a refund line), with optional sku and note

logo.description: A logo for the top of the receipt: exactly one of file_id, url or data_base64. PNG, JPEG or SVG, up to 2 MB (a PNG or JPEG also at most 2 megapixels, for example 1600×1250); the file's own bytes decide the type, not its name.

data_base64.description: Or base64 bytes of the logo, up to 2 MB decoded

file_id.description: A file_id from create_upload (after the PUT)

url.description: Or a public https URL of the logo

payment.description: How it was paid; replaces the template's payment

tax.description: Either a rate in percent or a fixed amount, with a label; replaces the template's tax

name: make_receipt
